scenePhases.scope: Disjoint CPU preparation, grid, component draw attempts grouped by sketch kind/type, connections, adorners and static scopes. Total includes unassigned transitions and probe overhead. Counts are attempts, not visible raster output.

profile.scope: Command invocation completion and CPU clear plus DrawingManager.Draw before overlay. Durations may overlap; do not add them. Neither is a GPU presentation timestamp. Phase profiling adds instrumentation overhead; use ordinary runs for acceptance.
